stages.name: Question
stages.en: Can visual observations and physical interventions reveal the causal structure?

stages.name: Pixel readout and calibration
stages.en: An anchored visual encoder reads seven states. Known target commands calibrate these readings.

stages.name: Observational graph
stages.en: 512 observation images produce this initial graph; 6 links remain unoriented.

stages.name: Select 1
stages.en: Round 1: select domino 1 (F1) from the unresolved links.

stages.name: initial
stages.en: The scene starts upright, before the selected operation.

stages.name: primary_approach
stages.en: The gripper approaches the domino 1 (F1).

stages.name: primary_hold
stages.en: Keep the domino 1 held inactive (F1=0) during the upstream push.

stages.name: root_approach
stages.en: The upstream gripper approaches the pusher.

stages.name: root_push
stages.en: The upstream gripper pushes the pusher; observe how the scene responds.

stages.name: root_retract
stages.en: The pushing gripper withdraws; the target remains held.

stages.name: observe
stages.en: Read the settled image before updating the graph.

stages.name: Reset
stages.en: Paired trial: same initial context, opposite target command.

stages.name: initial
stages.en: The scene starts upright, before the selected operation.

stages.name: primary_approach
stages.en: The gripper approaches the domino 1 (F1).

stages.name: primary_push
stages.en: The gripper activates the domino 1 by contact.

stages.name: primary_retract
stages.en: The gripper withdraws after contact.

stages.name: root_approach
stages.en: The upstream gripper approaches the pusher.

stages.name: root_push
stages.en: The upstream gripper pushes the pusher; observe how the scene responds.

stages.name: root_retract
stages.en: The gripper withdraws after contact.

stages.name: observe
stages.en: Read the settled image before updating the graph.

stages.name: Direct evidence 1
stages.en: The full batch supports 1 new edge direction, shown in blue.

stages.name: Graph update 1
stages.en: Graph rules orient 4 more links. 1 link remains unresolved. Fixed readings do not determine a direction.

stages.name: Reset
stages.en: Reset the physical scene; retain the graph learned so far.

stages.name: Select 2
stages.en: Round 2: select pusher (P) from the unresolved links.

stages.name: initial
stages.en: The scene starts upright, before the selected operation.

stages.name: root_approach
stages.en: The upstream gripper approaches the pusher.

stages.name: root_hold
stages.en: Hold the pusher at its inactive position (P=0).

stages.name: observe
stages.en: Read the settled image before updating the graph.

stages.name: Reset
stages.en: Paired trial: same initial context, opposite target command.

stages.en: The scene starts upright, before the selected operation.

stages.name: root_approach
stages.en: The upstream gripper approaches the pusher.

stages.name: root_push

stages.name: root_retract

stages.name: observe

stages.name: Direct evidence 2
stages.en: The full batch supports 1 new edge direction, shown in blue.

stages.name: Graph update 2
stages.en: All 6 links are now oriented.

stages.name: Learned result
stages.en: The learned graph after 2 rounds and 128 intervention images.

stages.name: Reset
stages.en: Extra physical verification: hold the bell striker. The learned graph remains frozen.

stages.name: initial
stages.en: The scene starts upright, before the selected operation.

stages.name: primary_approach
stages.en: The gripper approaches the bell striker (B).

stages.name: primary_hold
stages.en: Keep the bell striker held inactive (B=0) during the upstream push.

stages.name: root_approach
stages.en: The upstream gripper approaches the pusher.

stages.name: root_push
stages.en: The upstream gripper pushes the pusher; observe how the scene responds.

stages.name: root_retract
stages.en: The pushing gripper withdraws; the target remains held.

stages.name: observe
stages.en: Read the settled image; the learned graph remains frozen.

stages.name: Bell verification
stages.en: Image readouts with the striker held: bell B=0, lamp L=0.

scope: New seven-node physical simulation demonstration. All graph snapshots come from the frozen pixel/ACC discovery run; the extra bell hold is a separate physical verification. Not the paper aggregate and not evidence of calibration superiority.
presentation: Recomposited original robot frames; fixed cameras; English-only captions and labels; graph states from discovery logs. Static cards and explicit resets added. Timing follows original replay frame cadence, not a real-time physics claim.
